shoulder_rom_active_deg.name: Active Shoulder Elevation ROM
shoulder_rom_active_deg.definition: Range of motion excursion of dominant/active shoulder vertex

elbow_rom_active_deg.name: Active Elbow Extension ROM
elbow_rom_active_deg.definition: Range of motion excursion of active elbow joint

elbow_min_angle_deg.name: Minimum Elbow Angle
elbow_min_angle_deg.definition: Minimum interior angle at elbow (indicates flexor posturing/spasticity)

elbow_max_angle_deg.name: Maximum Elbow Extension Angle
elbow_max_angle_deg.definition: Maximum interior angle at elbow during extension phase

elbow_mean_angle_deg.name: Mean Elbow Angle
elbow_mean_angle_deg.definition: Temporal average of elbow interior angle

shoulder_mean_angle_deg.name: Mean Shoulder Angle
shoulder_mean_angle_deg.definition: Temporal average of shoulder elevation angle

wrist_vertical_excursion.name: Vertical Wrist Excursion
wrist_vertical_excursion.definition: Normalized vertical range of motion of wrist landmark

wrist_horizontal_excursion.name: Horizontal Wrist Excursion
wrist_horizontal_excursion.definition: Normalized horizontal range of motion of wrist landmark

wrist_max_reach_dist.name: Maximum Reach Distance
wrist_max_reach_dist.definition: Peak normalized Euclidean distance between wrist and shoulder

peak_elbow_angular_velocity_dps.name: Peak Elbow Angular Velocity
peak_elbow_angular_velocity_dps.definition: Maximum rate of change of elbow angle across execution

mean_elbow_angular_velocity_dps.name: Mean Elbow Angular Velocity
mean_elbow_angular_velocity_dps.definition: Average angular velocity magnitude of elbow joint

peak_shoulder_angular_velocity_dps.name: Peak Shoulder Angular Velocity
peak_shoulder_angular_velocity_dps.definition: Maximum rate of change of shoulder angle across execution

movement_smoothness_index.name: Movement Smoothness Index
movement_smoothness_index.definition: Inverse variance of joint angular acceleration (smoothness proxy)

bilateral_rom_asymmetry_deg.name: Bilateral Arm ROM Asymmetry
bilateral_rom_asymmetry_deg.definition: Absolute difference between left and right arm joint excursion ranges
